The spec required `membershipTier` to be `SILVER` when `namesakeCount` is 0 and an email is present, otherwise `BRONZE`, surfaced in the owner JSON response.

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `membershipTier` string property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field (and its setter).

   owner.getNamesakeCount() != null && owner.getNamesakeCount() == 0

   ```

**Structural-impact rationale:** I deliberately kept the logic out of the large `Owner` entity (whose high `WMC_other` would have made even a tiny new getter expensive) and out of any request-pipeline function class. Instead it rides on the mapper's already-CC-1 `toOwnerDto` method as a single annotation line, so `CC`, `changed_lines`, and the surrounding `WMC_other` all stay minimal. Two files touched, no method grown.
